name: Google Chrome
acquisition: pre-installed on the host; the harness records the executable name and browser version but never downloads, vendors or redistributes the browser
notes: The pinned major is the Q7a browser major; the harness records the exact patch version and refuses to call a different major a pinned-browser pass.
Playwright's chromium-headless-shell is not used because it is not a reliable WebGPU runner.
Software adapters (SwiftShader) are not requested; a software adapter result would not be a hardware pass.
